text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“A marriage of life♪ A miraculous harmony♪ 
Yes, your name is~♪”

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I'm sorry~, Earth-chan. That soy milk 
is sold out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth was disappointed that he 
couldn't drink the soy milk he had been 
looking forward to.
